notes.title: v1.0.6 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p]v1.0.6 Patch Notes[/p][p]• Fix: Loading could restore the save state from a different level.[/p][p]• Add: “Redo Swap.” After performing a Swap—and before your next drag—you can use the on-screen button or press Left Shift to return to the pre-Swap state.[/p]

notes.title: v1.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p]• Fix: Corrected several translation errors in the Simplified Chinese localization.[/p][p]• Improve: Refined Save/Load logic for greater stability.[/p][p]• Add: New PHYSICS “Accurate” mode — reduces clipping/penetration but makes rope drag slower.[/p]

notes.title: v1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p]Hi all![/p][p]v1.0.4 Patch Notes[/p][p]• Fix: Swap count did not reset after Save → Load.[/p][p]• Fix: When target Swap count is 0, UI showed “≤0”; now correctly shows “=0”.[/p][p]Thanks for playing and for your feedback![/p]

notes.title: v1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p]Hi all![/p][p]v1.0.3 Patch Notes[/p][p]• Fix: After clearing level 66, “Select Level” did not show Chapter 3 stages.[/p][p]• Fix: After viewing Credits, returning and opening any level left the “Thank You For Playing” label visible; it now hides as intended.[/p][p]Thanks for playing and for your support![/p]

notes.title: Unknot! Official Release & v1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p]Huge thanks to everyone who wishlisted, tried the demo, sent feedback, and purchased the game. Your support helped this one-dev project launch—and enabled the v1.0.2 hotfix within 48 hours.
What’s new:[/p][olist][*][p]Fix: Star wasn’t awarded when using fewer swaps than the target.[/p][/*][*][p]Audio: Soundtrack replaced with tracks by Jamesshu.[/p][/*][*][p]Mac: Launch issue fixed; if it still won’t start, please restart Steam and reinstall.
[/p][/*][/olist][p]If you’re enjoying Unknot!, a review or a share helps a ton. For issues, use the Steam discussions or email me at [url="https://kaxon.gxxx@gmail.com"]kaxon.gxxx@gmail.com[/url]. Thank you![/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes demo_0.3.3
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! Today we’ve released an update for [b]“Unknot!”[/b] – version 0.3.3 – bringing macOS support and a round of polish. Full details below:[/p][p][/p][h2]Key changes[/h2][olist][*][p]Added native macOS build – compatible with both Apple Silicon and Intel chips.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the volume of several chalk-related sound effects so they’re less harsh.[/p][/*][*][p] Refined knot-movement speed for a smoother, more responsive feel.
[/p][/*][/olist][p]As always, if you run into any problems or have feedback, please drop us a note in the Community Hub or email us. Thanks for playing![/p]

notes.title: Patch notes demo_0.2.4
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! We’ve just pushed an update for [b]Unknot![/b] that includes multiple bug fixes. If you encounter any issues, please report them in the community or by email.[/p]
